messages:
alex: Quick sync: we need a phased plan for v1 sunset that avoids surprise billing/ticket spikes. thinking: gradual grace-backoff + console banners + sampling for telemetry.
maya: agreed. key questions: how do we signal to downstream billing/alerts vs migration metrics? we often blur them.
jon: technical idea: add `X-Redwood-Deprecation-Mode: grace-backoff` header on routed requests that are on v1 by policy (not pinned). Tag in telemetry as `deprecated_route=true`. That lets billing ignore them for "spike" alerts but still count for capacity.
sara: UX needs: two banners in console: (1) tenant-facing migration notice with ETA, (2) internal dev flag showing "grace-backoff applied" with revoke button for CS. PM wants copy examples.
lucy: I'll mock the banners. internal one should show sponsor, applied_at, expiry, and reason. Also need a filter in the migration table for "grace-backoff" rows.
pm-ryan: PM note: marketing/legal want a standard minimum notice window (30 days) unless the customer opts in to stay. we should default to 30 days and allow CS revoke.
jon: runtime routing change: current path: pin -> header version -> fallback. New path: pin -> header version -> grace-backoff-check -> fallback. Grace-backoff should be idempotent and respect pin. pseudocode: if pin -> v1; else if header.v == v2 -> v2; else if grace_backoff(tenant) -> v1 with header X-...; else -> v2
maya: quotas: If we leave traffic on v1 under grace-backoff, that could block v2 capacity. Propose soft quotas: grace_rps and grace_tokens caps per tenant. Enforcement in quota layer and visible in console.
ops-bot: Note: autoscaler sees actual load; lots of grace traffic retained on v1 pools may increase v1 utilization. We need a global cap (percent of v1 capacity reserved for grace) and a hard limit to avoid OA.
sara: telemetry sampling: 100% sample of grace-backoff traffic for first 72h, then 5% after metrics stable. Key signals: per-tenant token delta, latency delta, billing delta, and route flip rate.
pm-ryan: Alert thresholds request: billing-delta > 25% for 24h OR v1_utilization > 65% => page ops. Also ticket to CS when revoke is used.
alex: rollout plan: feature flag "grace-backoff" behind canary + console opt-in. Canary 2% first hour, 10% next day, then ramp. Add ability to freeze ramp if alerts fire.
deploy-bot: CI: routing change + header injection + quota caps + telemetry flag built. Staging smoke ✅. Canary scheduled 2024-07-02 14:00 UTC at 2%.
jon: implementation owners: router/header/flag = jon, quota caps = alex, telemetry sampling = maya, console banners & revoke = sara, dashboard mocks = lucy, runbook = pm-ryan.
maya: runbook items: pre-canary baseline metrics, post-canary checks (billing-delta, v1/v2 util, sampling logs), rollback steps (turn off feature flag + revoke outstanding grace rows).
ops-bot: Reminder: add a metric to track "grace-backoff active tenants" and "grace tokens excluded from spike alerts" so SRE can see impact on alarms.
alex: I'll draft the internal doc + Ops runbook and post link here before canary. If anyone objects to the grace default (30d), flag now.
pm-ryan: doing legal check on required notice language. will post suggested copy.
lucy: will drop mocks by EOD today.
maya: I'll wire alerts and dashboards for canary. ping when runbook link is up.
jon: ready to land my router patch behind the flag. will link PR shortly.
